facts.note: Rosa states the kitchen clock is a quarter of an hour fast, kept so on purpose so nothing is late.
Lina came down at thirteen minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock and stayed until after the temple struck eleven.
Piano began at two minutes to eleven and stopped at eleven minutes past eleven, both by the kitchen clock.
Hall clock struck eleven when the kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven.

added.quote: Yes. Madame had told me to fetch Monsieur for the toast, so I went up to the atelier.
added.why: Places Rosa moving from the kitchen up to the atelier after the hall clock's strike (later than 11:13 by the kitchen clock), and shows Madame sent her, so Madame's instruction came before that movement. Timing relative to the temple's strike is not stated, so the exact window remains unclear.
